content:
emma: Heads-up team — cutting a runtime base-image rebase + cgroup namespace init-workflow today 14:30 PT. Need RBAC preflight, KMS key prep for cosign, and audit-forwarder smoke. Who's on? :eyes:
ryan: I'll take RBAC. Which SAs are touched?
emma: runtime-wkr, image-builder, signer-sa. Plan: drop CAP_SYS_ADMIN from runtime-wkr and scope signer-sa to registry:list+sign.
leila: I'll run vuln triage on the init image we're using (init-mv:2.0). Will report exploitable vs acceptable risk.
infra-bot: automated: created ticket SEC-9991 and runbook https://redwood-internal/runbooks/cgroup-init-cutover
sec-bot: automated: checklist created - [RBAC:false] [KMS:false] [Audit:false] [Vuln:false]
ryan: RBAC preflight commands I'll run:```sh
kubectl get rolebinding -n runtime runtime-wkr-binding -o yaml
kubectl auth can-i --as=system:serviceaccount:runtime:runtime-wkr mount sysfs
```
leila: quick scan: init-mv:2.0 flags CVE-2024-0001 in mount helper. Exploit requires writable /tmp + exec; we run init as root but no network egress. Risk low; patch ETA 1h.
emma: Ok for canary if init runs privileged only and main container unpriv. Update runbook with fallback and require audit fields to include init.image and init.pid.
ryan: Staging RBAC applied: removed cap from runtime-wkr SA. e2e canary failed at container start with "failed to move cgroup": init needs to perform the move.
leila: Recommends a minimal privileged init that exits quickly. I'll check init image patch meanwhile.
infra-bot: automated: created canary namespace runtime-canary-4466600123
ops-oncall: I'm on deck 14:30-15:30 PT. Will open #incident if error rate > 2x baseline.
ryan: Patch plan: deploy privileged init-only for canary, keep main unpriv. Will add TTL to init's RoleBinding to revoke later.
leila: vuln patch update: built init-mv:2.0-patched, running local scan now. ETA 20m for build+cosign.
emma: Devin (cc @devin) — please confirm KMS wrap workflow and key rotation plan for prod after canary green.
sec-bot: automated: please ensure cosign keys are in keystore and backup alias created
ryan: RBAC preflight checklist: binder exists, no cluster-admin remaining, run e2e smoke.
leila: local scan: patched init image removes the vulnerable helper binary; scan clean. Will cosign and push to staging.
emma: Good. Proceed with canary using privileged init. Leila, once patched image pushed, plan to replace privileged init with patched unpriv init tomorrow.
infra-bot: automated: canary deployment applied to runtime-canary-4466600123
ryan: Canary results: main containers run unpriv, init ran privileged and exited. No elevated shells. e2e smoke passed.
ops-oncall: Monitoring: error rate stable. No alerts yet. I'll hold for 15m then approve rollout.
leila: Pushed patched init to staging and cosign-signed. Verify command:```sh
COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign verify --key k8s://secret/keystore/staging/init-signer-pub.pem ghcr.io/redwood/init-mv:2.0-patched
```
emma: Sec, infra, ops — confirm audit-forwarding check will capture cosign.attestation, request.user, init.image and pod.name. Natalie in audit team will validate.
sec-bot: automated: checklist updated - [RBAC:true] [Vuln:patched] [KMS:staging-wrap:true] [Audit:canary-verified:false]
natalie: staging audit-forwarder: found events with trace id ci-4466600123; fields present: request.user=system:serviceaccount:runtime:runtime-wkr, init.image=ghcr.io/redwood/init-mv:2.0, cosign.attestation=true
emma: Great. Next: 14:50 PT prod canary with privileged init, then swap keystore alias and push patched init within 6h. Ops-oncall will monitor. If any anomalies, rollback to previous image and RBAC.
ops-oncall: I'll create rollback playbook now and standby.
ryan: One remaining: ensure signer-sa has limited registry ListObjects perms only on prefix "redwood/runtime/*" — will apply in prod.
sec-bot: automated: post-deploy checklist updated and archived run record SEC-9991
emma: Thanks team. Follow-ups: 1) rotate keystore alias tomorrow morning to enforce new cosign key 2) revoke privileged init via automation after patch 3) confirm audit retention and sample event logs in SIEM. :thumbsup:
